readings.Aries: Not everyone processes at your speed. Today, your patience is more powerful than your pace. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Taurus: There is more flexibility in you than your reputation allows. Show it to someone who needs to see it. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Gemini: The connection you're afraid of losing is already changing. Let it become what it needs to become. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Cancer: The feelings that seem too large to speak are usually smaller once they have words. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Leo: The person you're becoming requires a different audience than the person you were. Update accordingly. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Virgo: You've been adjusting yourself to fit a space that doesn't fit you. That adjustment has a cost. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Libra: The harmony you've created has required you to disappear into it. Reappear. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Scorpio: The wound is real. It is also not the whole story about you. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Sagittarius: The map is useful. The territory is better. Go off-map today. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Capricorn: Your ability to delay gratification is extraordinary. Some gratification is not supposed to be delayed. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Aquarius: Something you built to be useful has become something you're attached to. Worth knowing. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Pisces: You see people at their most essential. Let someone see you that way too. There's more support available than you've asked for.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
